assets.style: Cinematic semi-realistic digital painting, dramatic high-contrast lighting, warm golden candle light on the face against deep teal and violet shadows, emotional and intense, sharp focus on the eyes, one clear focal subject. The right half of the image is dark, calm, empty space for a title. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature.
images: On the left side, filling the left half: a close-up portrait of a young Korean woman in her twenties looking straight at the viewer with wide wet eyes and a single tear, a strange calm awakening on her face, warm candle light from below; behind her, out of focus, an old grand piano in a dark hall and a glowing hourglass

On the left side, filling the left half: a close-up portrait of a Korean man in his thirties staring straight at the viewer with an intense, haunted yet awakened gaze, half of his face lit gold and half in shadow; beside his face, a glowing hourglass with the golden sand almost run out
